name: ElevenLabs
summary: Market-leading AI voice platform: hyper-realistic text-to-speech (Eleven v4 and the low-latency v4 Turbo since September 2026), voice cloning, dubbing, sound effects and conversational agents — plus a developer API and, since August 2026, a hosted MCP connector that runs inside Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Free tier to test voices before you pay.
best_for: creators, developers and product teams that want the most realistic AI voices available — voiceovers, audiobooks, dubbing, conversational agents and a well-documented API
skip_if: you generate hours of long-form audio on a tight budget (credit math punishes volume — flat-hour tools or the TTS built into your video editor may be enough), or you need acted emotional range only a human voice actor delivers
honest_knock: Credits are the meter and retakes are the tax — you are charged per generation request, and a regeneration is only free while the content and settings are unchanged, so real usage lands well above the calculator estimate. And read the free-tier fine print: $0 gets you 10k credits to play with, but no commercial license — anything you publish commercially needs at least the $6 Starter. Voice realism genuinely leads the market; niche names and jargon can still need manual retakes, so run your hardest paragraph through the free tier before subscribing.

pricing.notes:
(re-verified 23 Sep 2026 on elevenlabs.io/pricing) Every rate held again, unchanged since August. Free $0 with 10k credits/mo; Starter $6/mo (30k credits, commercial license); Creator $22/mo — first month 50% off at $11 — with ~121k credits. Then Pro $99/mo (~600k credits, 44.1kHz PCM), Scale $299/mo (~1.8M credits, 3 workspace seats) and Business $990/mo (~6M credits, 10 seats). Extra usage runs roughly $0.36 down to $0.17 per additional minute depending on tier.

Two things the plan cards do not put next to the price. Annual billing is sold as ten months rather than twelve — the FAQ writes it out as annual price = monthly price × 10, which works out to $5 for Starter, $18.33 for Creator, $82.50 for Pro, $249.17 for Scale and $825 for Business. And credits are shared across every product, so speech, music, dubbing and video all draw down the same monthly balance. On a paid plan unused credits roll over for up to two months — the balance caps at three times the monthly quota — but downgrading or cancelling forfeits whatever is left at the end of the cycle, and the free plan has no rollover at all. Pay-as-you-go top-up credits sit outside that rollover cap, and upgrading carries unused credits into the next cycle. The FAQ now lists what the shared pool costs per product: text to speech 1 credit per character, speech to text 330 credits a minute, music 900 a minute, voice changer and isolator 1,000 a minute, sound effects 200 per generation, and dubbing 2,000 to 10,000 credits a minute depending on watermark and Studio.

A launch offer runs until 12 October 2026 (read 30 September 2026 on elevenlabs.io/pricing/api and the Eleven v4 launch post): API text to speech on Eleven v4 is $0.022 per 1,000 characters instead of $0.08, and on Eleven v4 Turbo $0.011 instead of $0.04, 72% off; the site banner also offers 3x credits on Creator and above until the same date. After 12 October the list rates apply.
